slides.name:
Anotyne
Nouel
slides.subtitle:
Producer, mixing & mastering engineer, Marseille.
Sound Love Studio. Trained at Sigur Rós's studio.

slides.kicker: Six months at Sigur Rós's studio
slides.quote: Being there, even in silence, really shaped me.
slides.sub: “Most of the time you have nothing to do, you're just listening. I didn't even notice, but I was learning so much.”

slides.quote: Nowadays you could engineer sound with just a pair of headphones.
slides.sub: “It's like the closest possible nearfield, but with the sound of main monitors.” Audeze LCD-5 + Violectric V550 Pro, no correction.

slides.quote: Monitoring is the most important piece of gear in the studio.
slides.sub:
Audeze LCD-5 · Yamaha NS10 · Avid S1 · Prism Titan
Mastering chain: Sontec → Manley Massive Passive → Smart C1

items.title: Arturia TAPE-201
items.text: “My favourite delay, and I love delays. I almost always spread it in stereo.”

items.title: UAD Manley Massive Passive
items.text: “Recalling the hardware is a pain. Being able to just drop the plugin on the master bus is easier.”

items.title: Uni-L · AL-1 · HiFAL · Sima
items.text: Limiters, high-frequency limiter and clipper, next to Weiss Deess, ATR-102 and Pro-Q 4.

slides.kicker: EQ and compression on the way in
slides.sub: “The sound I put in the computer should already be as close as possible to what I want. Less work, cleaner sound.”

slides.quote: Just do it! Don't wait for anyone's validation.
slides.sub: “A lot of women and queer artists desperately need people like us when it's time to produce their record.”

slides.quote: We're stronger and harder to break when we have each other's backs.
slides.sub: Full interview on our blog, link in bio · Follow @anotyne.tv
